# Which jobs make your shop money, and how many does the busy season have to sell?

> Free bike repair shop calculator: enter job prices, bench minutes, materials, technician pay, tools and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the plan result. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
